name: SPCX SpaceX Orbital Launch and Starlink Valuation
rationale: Space Exploration Technologies Corp. (SpaceX / SPCX) holds a global near-monopoly in orbital launch services and is scaling Starlink into the world's largest low-earth orbit constellation. TTM revenue reached $18.67B (+91.9% YoY). At $142.78 (secondary market pricing), our 5-year DCF yields a fair value of $287.12 (+101.1% upside at 12.0% illiquidity hurdle rate). Reverse DCF indicates the market is pricing in just 16.2% CAGR, well below our 25.0% base case. Recommendation: ACCUMULATE (Core Holding: 10.0 shares, 4.06% target weight). Accumulate on pullbacks near $125.67, trim Tier 1 at $250.00+.

bear.rationale: Starlink subscriber growth slows on Kuiper competition; Starship development delays extend FCF burn; Year 5 revenue $37.6B at 8% net margin.
risks: Amazon Project Kuiper commercial scaling eroding broadband ARPU
FAA and environmental regulatory litigation delaying Starship orbital cadence

base.rationale: Starlink reaches 25M+ subscribers globally with Direct-to-Cell rollout; Starship achieves regular commercial cargo cadence; $57.0B revenue at 18% net margin.
risks: Orbital debris mitigation constraints in low-earth orbit
High capital expenditure demands for next-generation V3 Starlink satellites

bull.rationale: Starlink becomes global connectivity backbone; Starship collapses launch cost per kg by 90%; xAI Colossus supercluster drives $86.8B revenue at 25% margin.
risks: Geopolitical spectrum licensing pushback from non-allied nations
Pre-IPO private share class liquidity restrictions
